text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've come to the mall looking for a few
things, but
it's quite busy today. Looks
like there might be
some kind of event
going on...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe they're holding a talk
show to
celebrate my plushies becoming
a huge hit...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone is so excited about it...
Including
me, of course! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Anyway, I better grab something
to eat
before it star—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! You're the one who saved
me back
then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap smiles and waves at me.
That's true—I
did save her from a
persistent reporter in the
past.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, I am. I'm happy to see you
here. My—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me! What do we have here?
Are you
two close?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm? Sorry, but who are you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Just your everyday reporter! But forget
about
me—is this person important to
you?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Are you tongue-tied, by any
chance? Don't
tell me your relationship
with this person would
disappoint your
fans—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I don't have time for questions
right now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The talk show starts in an hour anyway,
so
honestly, I don't see the point in
talking to you.
Let's go, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The way you handled the situation just
now was
truly admirable! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And to think that this is the person who
taught
you how to do it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, he told me I should refuse any
sketchy
interviews.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she told me I should refuse any
sketchy
interviews.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My fans care about me... So I need to
care about
myself too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now, that's just lovely! So that's how
your plushie
ended up with such a great
design! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's that got to do with my
plushie?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I think it's got everything to do with
it! I
heard the story from the designer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Your feedback was very honest and to
the point,
so they're very confident in
the finished product.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...They asked me for input, so I gave
them my
honest opinion.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, it's not fair to my fans if I
don't care
about myself... or my image.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the event. Since
you're here...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to have any advice to
give me
before the talk show?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to have any advice to
give me
before the talk show?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Hehe, got it. Catch you later.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
All right, then. Before we start, is there
anything
you'd like to say to your fans,
Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First of all, I want to thank everyone who
bought
my plushie.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Everyone worked hard to make this
project a
reality. Please treat these
plushies as kindly as
you would treat me.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: We'll treasure them! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haha...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Squeee! ☆ You're such a cutie,
Ogurin! ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
O-Ogurin... I'm not sure what to say to
that...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But thanks. Your words will give me the
extra
push I need to work hard!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Squeeee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's authenticity resonates
deeply with
her fans.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. Hearing your words fills me
with
strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks, everyone. I'm grateful to you all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's talk show turns out to be a
great
success.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Good question. But I think I get
what
you're trying to say—don't worry,
I'll follow my
heart.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
So, Oguri Cap, do you have any words
to mark
the release of your plushie?
Take it away!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well, about that. Today, I want the audience to ask me questions.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to have the opportunity to talk
with the
people who always cheer me
on. Do you have any
questions?

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Q-questions from us? Isn't this a talk
show? Um...
What should we ask her?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: I have one! Do you like plushies?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Everyone in my family does too.
They
asked me to send some back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, my mom calls the plushie
"Oguri Cap
the Second." I wonder who
the first is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her response sends warm laughter
throughout the
venue. She continues to
respond to questions
from her fans...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Any other ques—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrooowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Could I answer you after lunch?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Laughter fills the venue once again. The
talk show
perfectly encapsulates Oguri
Cap's laid-back
personality, leading to
its success.
